messages:
sara: Heads-up: vendor wants a full staging rehearsal tomorrow for the marketplace tile + SI flow. Main asks: legal-approved wording, partner logo proof, and telemetry checks. Who can lead the rehearsal?
omar: I can run the rehearsal for external comms and the blog snippet. Need legal signoff on partner mentions before we run.
jess: Product & design: well prepare the tile assets and a short walkthrough recording. Also well provide a lightweight embed snippet for partners to preview.
mike: Eng + Ops: well spin a staging instance at 10:30am PT, run SI integration smoke tests, and validate the entitlement check. Please share partner test creds by 9am.
sara: Legal-bot any blockers on partner attribution or co-marketing claims?
legal-bot: Auto-note: Partner names must use agreed trademark strings. No comparative claims allowed. Provide partner-approved quote or use neutral phrasing.
omar: OK we'll use a neutral quote placeholder: "integrating Redwood Inference reduced inference costs for our workload." Jess, can you include that as a draft?
jess: On it. Also adding two variations for the hero: product-focused and partner-focused. Which should we test in the rehearse?
sara: Test both in the staging rehearse, but default to product-first unless partner asks otherwise.
mike: Rehearsal checklist (short):
1) deploy marketplace tile to staging
2) run curl token exchange to validate SSO + entitlement
3) run SI end-to-end demo (sample request to partner connector)
4) capture video + screenshots for marketing
5) validate analytics event: marketplace.tile_view and marketplace.install

Use this curl to validate token exchange:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/validate -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_PARTNER_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","prompt":"ping"}' | jq .
```
mike: Expect 200 + {"ok":true, "entitled":true}. If entitled=false escalate to @sara + ops-bot.
sara: When we do the dry-run, please also trigger the rollback tag so we can practice quick revert. ops-bot can you schedule a temporary rollback window?
ops-bot: Rollback rehearsal window scheduled: 2045682600 (tomorrow 11:30am PT). Will post runbook link to channel 10m before.
omar: Press timing question  do we keep the combined announcement with partner or stagger? Partner asked for same-day co-announce. Thoughts?
jess: If co-announce, we need partner final assets + legal signoff by EOD today to hit our publish slot tomorrow. Otherwise stagger by 48hrs to let internal checks finish.
sara: I prefer same-day if they commit to assets. Omar, mark plan A = co-announce, plan B = stagger. Update blog draft with both CTAs.
omar: Will prepare both variants and tag team for review. Sending draft by 5pm.
mike: Ops note: analytics plumbing is ready but needs the partner_id mapping. Partner ops please confirm partner_id for staging.
sara: Partner ops confirmed partner_id = PART-842. Share test creds to mike + ops-bot.
jess: Also, design request: show both cloud marketplace badges (AWS + Azure) on the tile. Partner asked to include hardware partner icon (NVIDIA). Ensure proper spacing and SVGs.
sara: Good call. Legal-bot, any concerns with badges?
legal-bot: Badges ok if used per partner brand guidelines. Confirm with partner brand manager.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link -> https://intra.redwood/workflows/marketplace-rehearsal. Will collect post-mortem notes automatically.
sara: Thanks all. Action summary: Mike = staging deploy + smoke tests + rollback rehearsal; Jess = tile assets + hero variants + screenshots; Omar = blog + press variants; Sara = coordinate legal + partner signoff. Ping here when each step complete. :rocket:
